properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 MAC inside the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD envelope codec used for all WalletConnect relay payload encryption (EnvelopeType 0/1); quantum-safe symmetric authenticator, no migration required. Changeable here (first-party codec).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the SDK's identity/authentication signature: identity keys for the Keyserver, client-id JWTs and DID JWTs (EdDSA). Shor-vulnerable signature scheme, migration ML-DSA-65; keys live in the encrypted key chain (AES-256/ChaCha20-Poly1305 at rest). Changeable here (first-party + BouncyCastle 1.78.1).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 ECDH is the core key agreement of the WalletConnect pairing/session flow: generateAndStoreX25519KeyPair + X25519.scalarMult → HKDF-SHA256 → symmetric key + SHA-256 topic. Relay traffic is harvest-now-decrypt-later relevant; migration ML-KEM-768 (hybrid). Changeable here (first-party).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-GCM (AndroidKeyStore-backed, 256-bit keys) protects the SDK's stored key material at rest: EncryptedSharedPreferences master keys plus the release build's encrypted DB passphrase. Quantum-safe symmetric AE; no migration required. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF-SHA256 (RFC 5869, empty salt/info) is the KDF converting each X25519 shared secret into the 32-byte symmetric key used for envelope encryption; salt/info are empty byte arrays (no context binding). Quantum-safe KDF; no migration required. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD codec (BouncyCastle ChaCha20Poly1305 instantiated at ChaChaPolyCodec.kt:30) encrypting/decrypting WalletConnect relay message envelopes and keyserver payloads in the Android core — quantum-safe symmetric AEAD; the other 7 sites are unit tests of this codec. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256 (SIV for pref keys, GCM for values) is the AndroidX EncryptedSharedPreferences scheme protecting the SDK key chain and the encrypted DB-key store; 256-bit Grover margin, no migration required. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: java.security.SecureRandom seeds all key material: Ed25519/X25519 private keys, client-id JWT keypairs, ChaCha20-Poly1305 nonces and the SQLCipher DB passphrase (randomBytes). CSPRNG — no weakness; this is the good-practice counterpart of the kotlin.random ID generators tracked separately. Changeable here.
